texts.preamble: Saddam And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. The Prin. Secy. Food ... on 11 May, 2023 Bench: Rajan Roy, Manish Kumar High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench ? Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:32655-Db Court No. - 2 Case :- Writ - C No. - 2791 of 2023
texts.facts: This petition has been filed seeking following reliefs: "I- Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus thereby commanding the opposite parties not to interfere in the business of the petitioners during the pendency of the writ petition. Saddam And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. On 11.04.2023, we had passed the following order: "List/put up on 20.04.2023, as fresh to enable the counsel for Nagar Palika and the State Government to assist the Court as to who has the authority to interfere in the business of the petitioners which according to them is being carried on based on a valid license. Thereafter, we, after hearing the matter passed another order dated 20.04.2023 in the following terms: "Under the license granted to the petitioner, which is referrable to Schedule 4 Clause 9.07, wholesome meat obtained from the authorized slaughter house can only be sold at the meat shops, meaning thereby, it cannot be sold in open spaces outside the meat shop in respect of which the license has been granted.
texts.arguments: on 11 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181287809/ 1 I- Issue a direction to the opposite party no. 2 to decide the representation of the petitioners dated 23/02/2023 forthwith. III- Issue any order or direction or any other nature which this Hon'ble Court may think proper passed in interest of justice in favour of the petitioners." It shall also be informed to the Court as to whether under the license the petitioners can sell meat outside the shop in open space as is being alleged; if not, then, what are the remedial measures to be taken in this regard and how it would be ensured that they carry on their business only in accordance with the license inside the shop premises and not outside if the same is otherwise permissible." Sri Rohit Nandan Shukla, learned counsel says that he has instructions to inform the Court that opposite party no. 3, who is the Competent Authority has not taken any action under Section 32 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, meaning thereby, neither the license has been suspended nor cancelled. Learned counsel for Nagar Palika says that impugned order was passed as law and order situation had arisen and the Police had informed the Nagar Palika about it and this had arisen on account of sale of meat outside the meat shop. It is made clear that this order shall not come in the way of the opposite parties in taking any action against the petitioners, if the same is otherwise required as per law, which may include any action under criminal law. "
